melt.author: Melt
melt.notes: Existing HyperOS-oriented Melt-based marble source. Default for stock HyperOS.

lineageos.author: LineageOS
lineageos.rom_support: LineageOS and LOS-based custom ROMs only
lineageos.notes: Official LineageOS SM8450 kernel (Poco F5 / marble). Custom LOS-based ROMs only. Needs llvm-22.1.8 (armv9 flags).

evolution-x.author: Evolution-X
evolution-x.rom_support: Evolution X and LOS-based custom ROMs only
evolution-x.notes: Evolution-X device org SM8450 kernel for marble. Prefer clean branches without in-tree KSU. Needs llvm-22.1.8 (armv9 flags).

aosp-pablo.author: aosp-pablo
aosp-pablo.notes: GitHub org aosp-pablo SM8450 kernel (Marble Development). LOS-based custom ROMs only. Needs llvm-22.1.8 (armv9 flags).

pa-gr.author: pa-gr
pa-gr.notes: pa-gr SM8450 marble kernel (default branch vauxite). GKI fragments + llvm-22.1.8. Optional source_patches for Clang 22 KVM clidr (remove when upstream fixed). vauxite may ship in-tree KernelSU — smoke-test manager apply.

source_patches.notes: Clang 22 -Wuninitialized-const-pointer on sys_regs.c. Disable or delete when pa-gr/vauxite includes equivalent fix.
